verdict.rationale:
Notion exposes a REST API, personal access tokens, and webhooks for event-driven automation (e.g., page/database changes), which engineers could wire into external cron jobs or agent workflows for routine team tasks, but there is no documented native scheduling/cron trigger inside Notion itself — webhooks are event-triggered, not time-based.  
missing for 10: native schedule/cron trigger, built-in recurring-job runner, first-party example of a scheduled automation using the API.
